daily_schedule.morning_activity: Visit Senso-ji temple in Asakusa and stroll Nakamise Dori street stalls.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Culinary food tour through Tsukiji Outer Market sampling fresh sashimi and tamagoyaki.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Omakase sushi dinner at a Ginza multi-course sushi counter.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Otoro nigiri and uni flight with premium junmai daiginjo sake.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Tour Akihabara electronic district and retro gaming arcades.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Discover Ueno Park and the Tokyo National Museum culinary exhibit.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Yakitori experience under the train tracks in Yurakucho / Ginza Corridor.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Charcoal-grilled binchotan tsukune with raw organic egg yolk.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Cross Shibuya Scramble crossing and visit Meiji Shrine in Harajuku.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Shop luxury fashion along Omotesando avenue and stop at artisanal matcha cafes.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Cocktails at the Park Hyatt New York Bar overlooking Shinjuku skyline.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: A5 Wagyu beef teppanyaki cooked tableside with wasabi salt.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Explore teamLab Planets digital interactive art museum in Toyosu.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Visit Roppongi Hills Mori Art Museum and tranquil Mohri Garden.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Traditional seasonal kaiseki featuring matsutake broth and sweetfish.

daily_schedule.morning_activity: Walk through Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden and tea house ceremony.
daily_schedule.afternoon_activity: Souvenir hunting in Nihombashi traditional craft stores.
daily_schedule.evening_activity: Late night Tokyo ramen crawl in Shinjuku Golden Gai.
daily_schedule.highlight_cuisine: Rich tonkotsu broth ramen with handmade noodles and chashu.

local_tips: Purchase a digital Suica or Pasmo IC card on Apple/Google Wallet for transit and convenience store payments.
Tipping is strictly not customary in Japan; exceptional service is already included.
Carry a small bag for your trash, as public waste bins are rare in Tokyo.
